title: A Court Of Thorns And Roses
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: When nineteen-year-old huntress Feyre kills a wolf in the woods, a terrifying creature arrives to demand retribution. Dragged to a treacherous magical land she knows about only from legends, Feyre discovers that her captor is not truly a beast, but one of the lethal, immortal faeries who once ruled her world.

title: Percy Jackson And The Olympians: The Lightning Thief
author: Rick Riordan
summary: 12-year-old Percy Jackson discovers he is the son of Poseidon in the opener to the hilarious, fast-paced adventure fantasy series. Filled with magic, mythology, and plenty of monsters Percy Jackson is about to be kicked out of boarding school again — he can’t seem to stay out of trouble.

title: The Secret World of Maggie Grey
author: Granger
summary: A vampire, a witch, and a siren get accepted into a magical HBCU. The rest I am not allowed to say, but just know there is a talking cat named Quan, a few murders that went cold, and a world that is just below our feet.

title: Children of Blood and Bone
author: Tomi Adeyemi
summary: Zelie has one chance to bring back magic and strike against the monarchy. With the help of a rogue princess, Zelie must outwit and outrun the crown prince, who is hell-bent on eradicating magic for good.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia
author: C.S. Lewis
summary: Four adventurers step through a wardrobe and into the land of Narnia, a land enslaved by the power of the White Witch. But when almost all hope is lost, the return of the Great Lion, Aslan, signals a great change...and a great sacrifice

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
summary: Arthur Dent is swept off Earth just before it is destroyed and finds himself traveling through space with an unusual group of companions. His journey becomes a hilarious adventure filled with strange planets, bizarre situations, and unexpected discoveries.

title: Good Omens
author: Terry Pratchett and Neil Gaiman
summary: An angel and a demon who have grown rather fond of life on Earth discover that the apocalypse is approaching. Instead of welcoming the end of the world, the unlikely friends decide to work together to try to stop it.

title: The Princess Bride
author: William Goldman
summary: A fairy-tale adventure filled with romance, sword fights, revenge, unusual characters, and plenty of humor. The story follows Buttercup and Westley as they struggle to find their way back to each other.

title: Dial A for Aunties
author: Jesse Q. Sutanto
summary: After a disastrous blind date leaves Meddelin Chan with a very unexpected problem, she turns to her mother and meddling aunties for help. Their attempts to fix the situation lead to family chaos, romance, and increasingly hilarious complications.

title: Finlay Donovan Is Killing It
author: Elle Cosimano
summary: Finlay Donovan is a struggling novelist and overwhelmed mother whose conversation about her latest crime novel is mistaken for a discussion about a real murder-for-hire job. Soon, she finds herself caught in a mystery that feels far too much like one of her books.

title: Seven Days in June
author: Tia Williams
summary: Two successful writers unexpectedly reunite years after sharing an intense relationship as teenagers. As they reconnect over seven days, they must confront their past and decide whether their complicated love story deserves another chapter.

title: The Love Hypothesis
author: Ali Hazelwood
summary: Graduate student Olive Smith unexpectedly finds herself pretending to date a young professor. What begins as a fake relationship becomes increasingly complicated when their pretend romance starts producing very real feelings.

title: Get a Life, Chloe Brown
author: Talia Hibbert
summary: Chloe Brown creates a list of adventures to help herself live a more exciting life and recruits her building superintendent, Red, to help. As they spend more time together, their relationship begins developing into something neither expected.

title: The Wedding Date
author: Jasmine Guillory
summary: After getting stuck in an elevator together, Alexa Monroe agrees to accompany Drew Nichols to his ex-girlfriend's wedding. Their fake date leads to a connection that becomes much more complicated once the weekend ends.

title: Book Lovers
author: Emily Henry
summary: Literary agent Nora Stephens travels to a small town with her sister and repeatedly crosses paths with editor Charlie Lastra. Their encounters challenge the romantic stories they think they know and force them to reconsider what they actually want.

title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
author: Holly Jackson
summary: Pip Fitz-Amobi investigates a closed murder case for a school project because she is not convinced the person blamed for the crime was actually guilty. As she uncovers new evidence, she realizes someone in her town may be determined to keep the truth hidden.

title: The Thursday Murder Club
author: Richard Osman
summary: Four friends living in a retirement community meet regularly to investigate unsolved crimes. When a real murder occurs close to home, the amateur detectives suddenly have an active case to solve.

title: One of Us Is Lying
author: Karen M. McManus
summary: Five students enter detention, but only four leave alive. When investigators discover that each surviving student had a reason to want the victim silenced, everyone becomes a suspect in a mystery filled with secrets.

title: The Maid
author: Nita Prose
summary: Hotel maid Molly Gray discovers a wealthy guest dead in his room and soon becomes involved in the investigation. To clear her name, Molly must piece together the clues surrounding the mysterious death.

title: The Inheritance Games
author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
summary: Avery Grambs unexpectedly inherits a billionaire's fortune despite having no idea why he chose her. To receive the inheritance, she must live in his mansion with his suspicious family while solving the puzzles and secrets he left behind.

title: Incidents Around The House
author: Josh Malerman
summary: To eight-year-old Bela, her family is her world. There’s Mommy, Daddo, and Grandma Ruth. But there is also Other Mommy, a malevolent entity who asks her every day: Can I go inside your heart?

title: Mexican Gothic
author: Silvia Moreno-Garcia
summary: Noemi Taboada travels to an isolated mansion after receiving a disturbing letter from her newly married cousin. Inside the strange house, she encounters a secretive family, frightening visions, and mysteries that suggest something deeply sinister is happening.

title: The Haunting of Hill House
author: Shirley Jackson
summary: A small group arrives at the mysterious Hill House to investigate reports of supernatural activity. As unsettling events begin occurring, the house appears to have a particularly powerful effect on one member of the group.

title: The Southern Book Club's Guide to Slaying Vampires
author: Grady Hendrix
summary: A true-crime-loving book club begins to suspect that a mysterious new neighbor may be responsible for frightening events in their community. The members soon find themselves facing a threat far more dangerous than anything from their books.

title: How to Sell a Haunted House
author: Grady Hendrix
summary: After the death of their parents, estranged siblings Louise and Mark return home to prepare the family house for sale. But disturbing dolls, puppets, and unexplained events suggest that getting rid of the house will be much harder than expected.
